defs.def: not less than 至少；不少于

ex.s: I looked pointedly at the bookshelf that held at least three dictionaries, and Kevin sighed dramatically.
ex.t: 我特意看了看那个至少放着三本词典的书架，凯文夸张地叹了口气。

ex.s: Emotion was also important in convincing readers — or the lack of emotion, at least.
ex.t: 情感表达对于说服读者也很重要——或者说，情感的缺失至少同样重要。

ex.s: The 21st century has created a whole range of new types of professionals that we have never had before — or if not quite new, at least newly repackaged.
ex.t: 21世纪创造了一系列我们以前从未有过的新类型专业人士——或者即使不算全新，至少也是被重新包装过的。

ex.s: In a study published Wednesday in Environmental Science & Technology Letters, researchers from China found that boiling tap water for just five minutes — then filtering it after it cools — could remove at least 80 percent of its microplastics.
ex.t: 在周三发表于《Environmental Science & Technology Letters》的一项研究中，中国研究人员发现，将自来水煮沸仅五分钟——冷却后过滤——可去除其中至少80%的微塑料。

ex.s: Every time I gave a self-introduction, I had to explain how to pronounce my name at least five times, yet they still could not say it the way I did.
ex.t: 每次我作自我介绍时，都不得不把我的名字怎么读解释至少五遍，可他们还是说不出我那种读法。

ex.s: Do at least three projects.
ex.t: 至少完成三个项目。

ex.s: In the San Francisco Bay Area, at least.
ex.t: 至少在旧金山湾区是这样。

ex.s: Or at least work toward it.
ex.t: 或者至少朝着它努力。

ex.s: •At least three pair-teacher meetings
ex.t: •至少三次双人-教师见面会

ex.s: Did they follow those least willing to change their minds?
ex.t: 他们是否追随那些最不愿意改变主意的人？

ex.s: At least one thing proved truth: the color wouldn’t wash out.
ex.t: 至少有一件事被证明是真的：这颜色洗不掉。

ex.s: What Hammond is referring to is the question of meaning and meaning is central to what distinguishes the least intelligent of humans from the most intelligent of machines.
ex.t: 哈蒙德指的是意义问题，而意义是将最不聪明的人类与最聪明的机器区分开来的核心所在。

ex.s: •You have at least one year of work experience.
ex.t: •你至少有一年的工作经验。

ex.s: Having at least one-year work experience.
ex.t: 至少有一年的工作经验。

ex.s: Registration must be made at least two weeks in advance.
ex.t: 必须至少提前两周注册。

ex.s: I wasn't sure what it meant exactly, but at least we had a topic.
ex.t: 我不太确定这究竟是什么意思，但至少我们有了个话题。

ex.s: But it is always purposeful-or at least it should be.
ex.t: 但它总是有目的的——至少应该是这样。

ex.s: But using machine learning and artificial intelligence, some scientists propose that human diets consist of at least 26,000 biochemicals—and that the vast majority are not known.This shows that we have some way to travel before achieving the first objective of systems t hinking - which,in this example, is to identify more constituent parts of the nutrition system.
ex.t: 但是，利用机器学习和人工智能，一些科学家提出人类饮食至少包含26,000种生化物质——而且绝大多数是未知的。这表明我们在实现系统思维的第一个目标方面还有一段路要走——在这个例子中，就是识别营养系统的更多组成部分。

ex.s: We should have at least six to eight hours of sleep every day.
ex.t: 我们每天至少应该有六到八个小时的睡眠时间。

ex.s: It's the seaside birds that deserve at least part of the blame for getting Nick Burchill blacklisted at the Fairmont Empress Hotel in Victoria, Canada.
ex.t: 尼克·伯奇尔被加拿大维多利亚的费尔蒙帝后大酒店列入黑名单，至少有一部分责任要归咎于海边的鸟。

ex.s: "With our study, we think we can now confidently conclude that at least some dogs can distinguish human facial expressions," Muller told Live Science.
ex.t: "对我们来说最可能的解释是基础在于它们与人类的生活这给了它们大量接触人类面部表情的机会，"穆勒说而这种接触为它们提供了许多学习区分的机会。

ex.s: You must be at least 20 years old．
ex.t: 你必须至少年满20岁．

ex.s: At least 80 inches of rain a year is normal-and in some areas there may be as much as 430 inches of rain annually.
ex.t: 每年至少80英寸降雨量是正常的——而在某些地区，年降雨量可能高达430英寸。

ex.s: Morgan says，”To give people a guilt-free option that they can wear without someone throwing paint on them-1 think that’s going to be a massive thing, at least here in New York.” Designer Jennifer Anderson admits it took her a while to come around to the opinion that using nutria fur for her creations is morally acceptable.
ex.t: 摩根说：“给人们一种毫无愧疚感的选择，让他们穿上也不会被人泼油漆——我认为这会是一件大事，至少在纽约这里。”设计师詹妮弗·安德森承认，她花了一段时间才接受在其创作中使用海狸鼠毛皮在道德上可以接受的观点。

ex.s: The doorway to peace and quiet, for Nick Bright at least, leads straight to his mother-in-law, she lives on the ground floor, while he lives upstairs with his wife and their two daughters.
ex.t: 对于Nick Bright来说，通往宁静的入口直通他岳母那里，她住在一楼，而他楼上和妻子及两个女儿住在一起。

ex.s: At least it seems that way.
ex.t: 我可以从家里的电脑上调出Juan村庄的卫星图像。

ex.s: You have to be at least a bit self-assured to laugh at yourself in front of others.
ex.t: 你至少要有一点自信，才能在别人面前自嘲。

ex.s: It was time to say goodbye for now at least.
ex.t: 全家人含着泪微笑着拥抱，然后笑了。

ex.s: “We found that the least well-liked teens had become more aggressive over time toward their classmates.
ex.t: "我们发现最不受欢迎的青少年随着时间的推移变得越来越具有攻击性。

ex.s: Which of the following uses the least energy?
ex.t: 以下哪种设备耗能最少？

ex.s: One study found that a cotton bag must be used at least 131 times to be better for the planet than plastic.
ex.t: 一项研究发现，一个棉布袋必须至少使用131次，才比塑料袋对环境更有利。

ex.s: You need to    61   (real)read at least one good book a week, preferably a classic.
ex.t: 你需要____61____（真正）每周至少读一本好书，最好是一本经典。

ex.s: This is why, in part at least, the US National Climate Assessment says that: ＂There is no ‘one-size fits all’ adaptation.＂ Nevertheless, there are some actions that offer much and carry little risk or cost.
ex.t: 这就是为什么，至少部分地，美国《国家气候评估》说：“没有‘一刀切’的适应。”尽管如此，有些行动收益大、风险和成本却小。

ex.s: You should exercise for at least half an hour each day.
ex.t: 你应该每天锻炼至少半小时。

ex.s: What food or drink do they have least frequently?
ex.t: 哪种食物或饮料他们最不常吃/喝？

ex.s: But at least the report shows that things are moving slowly in the right direction.
ex.t: 但至少报告显示事情正在朝着正确的方向缓慢发展。

defs.def: （用于对否定情况补充肯定的评论）起码
even if nothing else is true or you do nothing else 无论如何；反正

ex.s: What you did on the spacecraft: How you felt: What you enjoyed most/least: Now write your journal entry.
ex.t: 你在宇宙飞船上的行动： 你的感受： 你最喜欢/最不喜欢什么： 现在写下你的日志条目。

defs.def: （用以减轻前面所说的话的肯定性）至少

ex.s: As she talked, I could hear at least three different languages being spoken at the tables around us.
ex.t: 在她说话的时候，我能听到至少三种不同的语言在周围桌子间被使用。
